items.title: Wycliffe Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I think it’s great simply for this reason. It’s something positive about our music that’s being done, it’s televised and given to the masses.

ctx.x: What do you think about it?

I think it’s great simply for this reason. It’s something positive about our music that’s being done, it’s televised and given to the masses. Amongst the musicians there’s been controversy, there’s too much Wynton Marsalis on it, or they didn’t cover anything after 1965 or they didn’t talk about all the piano players. I say yeah if they didn’t talk about © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

piano players, imagine what they did to the trombone. They didn’t say anything about — and you know I didn’t watch. I don’t get a chance to watch much television so I bought the video box set and I will get a chance to watch it at my leisure. But I was out, we were doing a residency activity in Decorah, Iowa somewhere, it was a part of a grant that they had to bring Lincoln Center out to do jazz workshops and residences in rural areas. And the Ken Burns series, it was a couple of months ago, it was in February,…
